responsibility: This file implements full front-end expression folding for C after initial parsing. It recursively folds trees while preserving C constant-expression semantics, tracks whether expressions remain valid integer or initializer constants, suppresses warnings in unevaluated or short-circuited subexpressions, handles C-specific cases such as string ARRAY_REF folding and SAVE_EXPR state, and returns trees annotated for later diagnostics and gimplification.
